467:t_1:3.en: ～ $$地球連邦軍$$ Far East Branch - Private Room ～

467:t_1:7.en:
$$甲児$$
(Whoever it was, they really did speak to me... They said they're holding Mom...)

467:t_1:8.en:
$$甲児$$
(I have no choice but to go...)

467:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「I see... So that message reached you too.」

467:t_1:17.en:
$n
「Yeah... Though I can't tell what they're after.」

467:t_1:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Did you tell everyone about this?」

467:t_1:20.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm begging you... Don't tell anyone.」

467:t_1:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「If I make one wrong move, there's no telling what they'll do to Mom.」

467:t_1:22.en:
$n
「It's definitely a trap. ...I don't know why they'd do something like that, though...」

467:t_1:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm going anyway... I'll save Mom with my own hands!」

467:t_1:26.en:
$n
「Don't worry about it. ...I still haven't fully worked through what happened with my mom, but it's in the past...」

467:t_1:27.en:
$n
「Go, $$甲児$$. I'll pretend I didn't see anything.」

467:t_1:29.en:
$n
「But if $$マジンガー$$ sorties, somebody will notice right away. And then $c will sortie too.」

467:t_1:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「They told me to come alone. I'll settle this before everyone gets there.」

467:t_1:31.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even if I end up fighting them...」

467:t_1:34.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ aren't around. If I'm gone, there'll be nobody left to look after you.」

467:t_1:35.en:
$n
「Yeah, that's right. I won't let you walk away with a win in our mock battle.」

467:t_1:38.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Is this okay...? Letting him go like that...」

467:t_1:40.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hey, $n... We can't step in ourselves, but we can back him up, can't we?」

467:t_1:41.en:
$n
「Of course. That's what I intend to do.」

467:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Besides, there's something I have to find out for myself.」

467:t_2:5.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「You sniffed out this place...!?」

467:t_2:6.en:
$n
「...You two are under $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, aren't you...」

467:t_2:7.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「Now that it's come to this, there's no need to hide it. We are those who watch over humanity's evolution... the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

467:t_2:8.en:
$n
「Strange... However I look at you, you don't seem like soldiers with proper training...」

467:t_2:9.en:
$n
「I checked places near the abandoned $$科学要塞研究所$$ that could serve as a hideout, but...」

467:t_2:10.en:
$n
「Even this place is a pitifully crude camouflage to a $$ビーストハンター$$ like me.」

467:t_2:12.en:
$n
「Don't think you can win when you can't rely on your machines' performance!」

467:t_2:15.en:
$n
(How little resistance they put up... It's almost unnatural...)

467:t_2:18.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Right now I'm $$コード：ホワイト$$... a strike team member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

467:t_2:19.en:
$n
「Why...? Why would $$マキ#pilot$$ be with $$クロノ$$...」

467:t_2:20.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I became a member around last April... They scouted me, saying I had potential.」

467:t_2:22.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「That's right. I joined $$クロノ$$ to change the world.」

467:t_2:23.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I never thought I'd end up fighting you, though...」

467:t_2:24.en:
$n
「Was what you told me on $$翠の地球$$ a lie!?」

467:t_2:25.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「A lie...? I never told one.」

467:t_2:26.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I'm both the nurse $$柏葉真紀$$ and $$クロノ$$'s $$コード：ホワイト$$.」

467:t_2:27.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Until the Captain gave orders, I was just a nurse working in Japan.」

467:t_2:28.en:
$n
「What does 'change the world' even mean!? Does it have something to do with the Reformists' 'watching over humanity's evolution'!?」

467:t_2:29.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You don't need to know that. We just follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders.」

467:t_2:30.en:
$n
「That's absurd! You joined $$クロノ$$ without even knowing what it does!?」

467:t_2:33.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain is worthy of trust... Isn't that enough?」

467:t_2:35.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「This is a good chance, $n. I'll forgive you for raising your sword against the Captain.」

467:t_2:36.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「So come with me. I'm sure the Captain will take you in if you apologize.」

467:t_2:38.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Let's go, $n. ...Or won't you listen to my request?」

467:t_2:40.en:
???
「...Whoops, looks like I've interrupted a perfectly good love scene.」

467:t_2:42.en:
$$安$$
「Don't worry, $n. This washed-up cop is on our side. For now, anyway.」

467:t_2:43.en:
$n
「$$安$$ of the $$くろがね五人衆$$!」

467:t_2:44.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Time to greet a face I've never seen.」

467:t_2:45.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Being a cop is ancient history. These days I'm Dr. $$剣造$$'s bodyguard. The name's $$暗黒寺$$.」

くろがね五人衆.evidence: 467:t_2:43: Hibiki introduces 安 as a member of the くろがね五人衆 (Yasu, Ankokuji and the other Kurogane-ya allies of the Kabuto family in Mazinger Edition Z); no glossary entry.

kept_omissions: 467:t_1:7: あいつ (the one who spoke to Kouji and holds his mother) - the scene never names the speaker or gender; rendered 'Whoever it was, they'.
467:t_1:22 / 467:t_1:30 / 467:t_1:31: あいつ = the same unnamed captor, rendered with 'they'.
467:t_1:41: 無論、そのつもりだ - subject 'I' (Hibiki), 'assist' object left implicit (Kouji).
467:t_2:6: お前達、アドヴェントの配下か - subject you (the two Chrono members); 'under Advent' rendered as 'under $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'.
467:t_2:12: 機体の性能に頼れない状況 - 'your machines' assumed (Chrono members fighting on foot).
uncertain: 467:t_1:3 caption: 極東支部 rendered as plain 'Far East Branch' after $$地球連邦軍$$; separator '-' for the fullwidth-space caption layout.
467:t_1:7/22/30/31: Kouji's captor is unnamed, so gender-neutral 'they'.
467:t_2:9/10: 科学要塞研究所 rendered plain 'Science Fortress Research Institute' (no glossary entry).
467:t_2:18: 実行部隊隊員 = 'strike team member'; bare 隊長 = 'the Captain' (Advent), 'Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$' when named.
467:t_2:25: 嘘…？そんなもの言ってないわ = 'A lie...? I never told one.'
467:t_2:43: くろがね五人衆 proposed as 'Kurogane Five' (new keyword token $$くろがね五人衆$$).
467:t_2:44: 見ねえ顔に挨拶だ - Ankokuji introducing himself to Hibiki, rendered 'Time to greet a face I've never seen.'
467:t_2:20: 去年の４月くらい = 'around last April'.
